capabilities: Compare two notes or text files in synchronized panes
Highlight changed lines and inline differences
Accept or ignore individual changes and whole blocks
Edit the target file and save changes only on request
Compare an external .md file dropped from the desktop
extras: Runs fully offline with no account, network requests or telemetry. Mobile support exists but Android and iOS device validation is pending. Saving an external file depends on the Obsidian installer's browser runtime, and a read-only snapshot is used when writable file handles are unavailable.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to see line-level differences between two notes or to merge selected edits from one version into another.
summary: Markdown diff viewer that compares two notes or text files side by side, highlights changes, and lets you accept or ignore them before saving.
